title: Is Technology Enough?  An Anthropologist Looks at the Meaning of Communication
location: Plaza 2,  Doubletree by Hilton Hotel, Minneapolis South, 7800 Normandale Boulevard, Minneapolis, MN 55439
description: A presentation on how anthropologists study disability, with examples from *Beautiful Mystery: Living in a Wordless World* and three recent books on language, communication, and technology that focus on disabled people in India and the U.S
